We need to classify relation between two yes/no questions.

Q1: "O saque-aniversário do FGTS deve ser mantido?" (Should the FGTS birthday withdrawal be kept?)

Q2: "O saque-aniversário do FGTS deve ser substituído por empréstimo consignado com juros mais baixos?" (Should the FGTS birthday withdrawal be replaced by a payroll loan with lower interest?)

These are different questions. Q1 asks about maintaining the existing policy. Q2 asks about replacing it with a different instrument. They are not opposite polarity; they are different issues. So relation = DIFFERENT.

Reasoning: The questions address different policy options; one about keeping the current withdrawal, the other about substituting it with a loan. Answering yes to one does not determine answer to the other.
